Falcons vs Saints DraftKings Showdown Picks: Monday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Monday Night Football, October 5 · NFL Week 4 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 4, 12:20 PM ET

Bijan Robinson has the highest SPAGS projection in the Falcons at Saints DraftKings Showdown: 22.7 points at $11,800 FLEX, 34.1 at captain for $17,700. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson holds 72% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Robinson is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 10.8 points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, in a game with a 47.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 25.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Robinson at captain. Tyler Shough is the next captain in line, at 17.6%. The model has him running 3.9 times.

New Orleans is a 1.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 24.5 for the Saints and 23 for the Falcons.

Behind Robinson and Shough, the next projections are Chris Olave (19.1, $10,800), Drake London (16.5, $10,000) and Michael Penix Jr. (16.1, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 4, 12:20 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

MNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 25.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 22.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 34.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.1 carries and 5.0 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 22.7 points with a simulated floor of 10.8 and a ceiling of 39.1. He holds 72% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 25.1% as the captain and 47.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Tyler Shough, NO QB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Tyler Shough holds 17.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 19.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Shough averaged 20.1 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 36.6. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.6% as the captain and 53.4% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Drake London, ATL WR ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Drake London holds 14.3% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.5-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.3 targets on 22.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations London averaged 16.6 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 36.2. He holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.3% as the captain and 29.2% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Falcons vs Saints

Chris Olave, NO WR ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations Olave averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 38.0. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.2% as the captain and 40.2% in a FLEX spot.

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Michael Penix Jr. carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.1 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). Across 10,000 simulations Penix averaged 16.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.4 and a ceiling of 29.9. He holds 49% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.7% as the captain and 45.1% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 11.4 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 26.8. He holds 28% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.9% as the captain and 23.4% in a FLEX spot.

Build around Noah Fant at captain with Bijan Robinson, Tyler Shough and Drake London at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (21 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $12,000 for the last two FLEX spots.

Bijan Robinson leads the SPAGS model at 22.7 DraftKings points for $11,800 at FLEX, or 34.1 points at captain for $17,700.

Bijan Robinson is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Olamide Zaccheaus (4.0 points at $2,000), Daniel Carlson (9.3 points at $4,800) and Jahan Dotson (5.7 points at $3,000).

The Saints are a 1.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 47.5, with implied team totals of 24.5 for the Saints and 23 for the Falcons.
